# tarca

> A zero-dependency TypeScript client for the Billingo API v3 (Hungarian invoicing), the sibling of kassza (Számlázz.hu). Status 0.x: all 57 Billingo operations are implemented (invoices, proformas, advance invoices, receipts, cancellations, modification documents, payments, PDFs, partners, products, inventory, document blocks, bank accounts, spendings, exports) and run in a live end-to-end test on a Billingo developer test profile. Exactly-once issuing with `createOnce` and a `vendorId`. Add-on subpaths: `tarcajs/payments` (Stripe, SimplePay, Barion, Revolut and PayPal webhooks to a receipt or invoice exactly once, refunds), `tarcajs/storage` (PDFs to S3, R2, Vercel Blob, Supabase, disk), `tarcajs/stores`, `tarcajs/journal`, `tarcajs/batch`, `tarcajs/observe`, `tarcajs/node`, `tarcajs/mcp` (an MCP server with confirmed writes) and the `tarcajs` CLI (`npx tarcajs doctor`). Ships TypeScript types for every Billingo schema, generated from the official OpenAPI spec and corrected where the live API differs, and `tarcajs/testing` (an in-memory fake Billingo and a mock client). Retries only GET requests, never writes. Runs on Node 22+, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers and Vercel Edge. Independent open-source project, not a Billingo product.
